user.title: DALI USB (Helvar 510)
user.description: Connect the 510 USB-DALI interface. The bus is scanned with queries only (no addressing, no scene or group writes).

strips.title: Assemble RGB/RGBW strips
strips.description: Found {count} DALI control gear and {suggestions} suggested multi-channel strip(s). Assemble a strip from 3 (RGB) or 4 (RGBW) short addresses, or skip. Suggested addresses: {suggestion}.

data.name: Name
data.add_another: Add another strip after this one

confirm.title: Confirm

data.hide_group_members: Hide lights that are members of a DALI group (they stay enabled)

edit_strip.title: Edit strip
edit_strip.description: Current: {strip}. The strip entity, its name, aliases, area and device are kept; only channels, name and mode change.

send_raw.name: Send raw DALI frame
send_raw.description: Advanced (admin only): sends one 16-bit DALI forward frame. Configuration and commissioning commands are refused.

add_to_group.name: Add gear to DALI group
add_to_group.description: Admin only: sends DALI ADD TO GROUP (0x60+group) twice to ONE short address and verifies with QUERY GROUPS.

group.name: Group
group.description: DALI group 0-15 (tools that number groups 1-16 call group 4 "Group 5")

method.name: Send-twice method
method.description: auto = the 510's send-twice bit, falls back to two frames if not verified

remove_from_group.name: Remove gear from DALI group
remove_from_group.description: Admin only: sends DALI REMOVE FROM GROUP (0x70+group) twice to ONE short address and verifies with QUERY GROUPS.
